meta.title: Cosmic Evolution
meta.description: The Starlight Chocolate melts and the universe falls silent with it. We have one last piece left.

units.rawText: Splendorous stardust, as searing hot as a heart.
units.displayText: Splendorous stardust, as searing hot as a heart.

spans.text: Splendorous stardust, as searing hot as a heart.
